OTC_DISK1, OTC_DISK2 and lsblk are names to type; keep them as they are. Something on that disk is in use, often the system itself: {where} is where it is mounted, for example / or /boot, or [SWAP]. Nothing was erased.

wiz.install.error.disk_twice.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 5, installing: why the install failed, under the progress bar. {disk} is a disk's device name, for example /dev/sda. OTC_DISK1, OTC_DISK2 and lsblk are names to type; keep them as they are. The same disk was named for both halves of the mirror (two disks holding the same copy).

wiz.install.error.stage_source.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 5, installing: why the install failed, under the progress bar. The release's source code could not be put in place.

wiz.profile.drag_hint.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the device-name step's optional "Your profile" section: hint under the zoom slider: the picture can be dragged inside the round crop.

wiz.profile.faces_hint.text: Groups the same people across your photos so you can search by person. It runs only on this device, but it looks at everyone in your photos, not just you. Off unless you tick it.
wiz.profile.faces_hint.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the device-name step's optional "Your profile" section: explanation under the face recognition checkbox. Consent text: keep every fact (only on this device, everyone in the photos, off unless ticked).

wiz.profile.faces_label.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the device-name step's optional "Your profile" section: checkbox that turns face recognition on (off unless ticked). Consent to processing biometric data.

wiz.profile.name_label.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the device-name step's optional "Your profile" section: label of the field for the owner's name, as friends see it.

wiz.profile.name_placeholder.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the device-name step's optional "Your profile" section: placeholder in the Your name field.

wiz.profile.optional.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the device-name step's optional "Your profile" section: in grey after the heading Your profile.

wiz.profile.optional_hint.text: All of this is optional - you can set it later in Settings.
wiz.profile.optional_hint.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the device-name step's optional "Your profile" section: last line of the section. Settings is the device's Settings section in the apps.

wiz.profile.picture_label.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the device-name step's optional "Your profile" section: label of the profile picture picker (a file button and a round crop preview).

wiz.profile.title.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the device-name step's optional "Your profile" section: its heading. Followed by "(optional)" in grey.

wiz.profile.zoom.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the device-name step's optional "Your profile" section: label of the slider that zooms the profile picture in its crop.

wiz.ready.back.text: Your device is back, with everything it had.
wiz.ready.back.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the last screen, once installed: first line after recovering a device.

wiz.ready.choose_password.text: Choose its password below - the app then opens it straight away.
wiz.ready.choose_password.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the last screen, once installed: in the app, after installing: the app's password field follows.

wiz.ready.enter_password.text: Enter its password below to open it in the app.
wiz.ready.enter_password.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the last screen, once installed: in the app, after recovering: the app's password field follows.

wiz.ready.from_now.text: From now on it lives at
wiz.ready.from_now.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the last screen, once installed: in a browser, after the first line; the device's address follows on a line of its own.

wiz.ready.hotspot_off.text: The "Off The Cloud" hotspot switches off in a minute.
wiz.ready.hotspot_off.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the last screen, once installed: last line: the device's own Wi-Fi hotspot (named "Off The Cloud"; keep the name) goes away.

wiz.ready.installed.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the last screen, once installed: first line after installing.

wiz.ready.lives_at.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the last screen, once installed: in the app, after the first line. {domain} is the device's internet address, in bold.

wiz.ready.local_hint.text: Everything is installed. On your home network the device answers at
wiz.ready.local_hint.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the last screen, once installed: line for a device without an account; the address (http://otc.local:8080) follows on a line of its own.

wiz.ready.local_open.text: Open that address from any device at home - it will ask you to choose the owner password first. Want it reachable from anywhere later? Create an account at {bridge} and run the setup again.
wiz.ready.local_open.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the last screen, once installed: line under the address of a device without an account. {bridge} is the bridge's address (off-the.cloud).

wiz.ready.open_address.text: Open that address in your browser - remember it, it is how you reach your device from anywhere.
wiz.ready.open_address.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the last screen, once installed: in a browser, under the device's address.

wiz.ready.owner_password.text: It will ask you to choose the owner password first.
wiz.ready.owner_password.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the last screen, once installed: in a browser, after installing, following "Open that address in your browser…".

wiz.ready.title.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): the last screen, once installed: its heading. Keep the emoji.

wiz.wifi.bands_signal.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: small text at the right of each network in the list. {bands} are its bands, for example "2.4 · 5"; {signal} is its signal strength in percent.

wiz.wifi.choose_app.text: Choose the network the device should use - 2.4 or 5 GHz.
wiz.wifi.choose_app.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: hint in the apps' Bluetooth setup, where any band works.

wiz.wifi.choose_hotspot.text: Choose the network the device should use. Over this hotspot it joins on 2.4 GHz and moves to 5 GHz once set up; a network that is only 5 GHz needs the app's "Set up a new device" (Bluetooth).
wiz.wifi.choose_hotspot.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: hint over the device's own Wi-Fi hotspot, where only 2.4 GHz networks can be joined. "Set up a new device" is the apps' button: use its translation, in quotes.

wiz.wifi.enter_password.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: error when Connect is pressed for a secured network with no password. {ssid} is the network's name.

wiz.wifi.failed.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: error when the join request failed and the device said nothing more.

wiz.wifi.hotspot_back.text: The hotspot is back - reconnect to it.
wiz.wifi.hotspot_back.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: follows a join error over the device's own Wi-Fi hotspot: the phone has to rejoin it.

wiz.wifi.join_failed.text: Could not join that network - check the password.
wiz.wifi.join_failed.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: error under the buttons when joining the network failed.

wiz.wifi.join_rejected.text: Could not join that network - check the password and try again.
wiz.wifi.join_rejected.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: error under the buttons when the device could not join the network (the device's own words, shown as they come in English until translated).

wiz.wifi.joining_title.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: heading while the device joins the network. {ssid} is the network's name. The number and the middle dot ("1 · ") are the step's number; keep them.

wiz.wifi.joining_wait.text: Connecting and waiting for the internet - up to a minute.
wiz.wifi.joining_wait.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: line with a spinner while the device joins the network.

wiz.wifi.keep_open.text: Keep this page open - it continues on its own once the device is online.
wiz.wifi.keep_open.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: hint while the device joins the network.

wiz.wifi.none.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: the network list while it is empty. Scan is the Scan again button.

wiz.wifi.online.text: The device is online. You can continue, or join a different network.
wiz.wifi.online.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: hint when the device is already online (over a cable, so no Wi-Fi network to name).

wiz.wifi.online_via.text: The device is online via {ssid}. You can continue, or join a different network.
wiz.wifi.online_via.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: hint when the device is already online. {ssid} is the Wi-Fi network's name, in bold.

wiz.wifi.only_5ghz.text: 5 GHz only - use the app to join it
wiz.wifi.only_5ghz.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: small line under a network in the list that only exists on 5 GHz, which this hotspot can't join.

wiz.wifi.password_for.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: placeholder in the password field once a network is picked. {ssid} is the network's name.

wiz.wifi.pick_first.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: placeholder in the (disabled) password field before a network is picked.

wiz.wifi.reconnect.text: If you get disconnected, reconnect to the "Off The Cloud" WiFi. The hotspot restarts for a few seconds to switch to your network's channel; most phones rejoin it by themselves, but if yours doesn't, pick "Off The Cloud" again in your WiFi settings and come back to this page.
wiz.wifi.reconnect.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: box shown while the device joins the network, over its own hotspot ("Off The Cloud" is the hotspot's Wi-Fi name; keep it). The first sentence is in bold.

wiz.wifi.scan_again.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: button that looks for Wi-Fi networks again.

wiz.wifi.scanning.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: next to Scan again, with a spinner, while networks are being looked for.

wiz.wifi.title.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: the step's heading. The number and the middle dot ("1 · ") are the step's number; keep them.

wiz.wifi.wrong_password.text: A wrong password shows up here as an error; just try again.
wiz.wifi.wrong_password.note: Setup wizard (the page a new device shows in the apps' Bluetooth setup, or in a browser): step 1, joining the device to a Wi-Fi network: hint while the device joins the network.
